name: Copacabana
description: Rio's most famous beach neighborhood, a dense stretch of apartment towers, hotels, bars and its legendary curved beach. Lively day and night with metro access, endless services and a mix of tourists and locals, it is a convenient nomad base.
bestFor: Nomads wanting beachfront energy, metro access and abundant services

name: Ipanema
tagline: Chic beach neighborhood with cafe culture
description: An upscale, stylish beachfront district beloved for its beach, boutiques, cafes and restaurants. Safer and more polished than Copacabana, Ipanema offers a sophisticated scene, tree-lined streets and easy metro links, making it a top choice for remote workers.
bestFor: Nomads wanting a stylish, safer beach area with cafes and dining

name: Botafogo
tagline: Hip bay neighborhood loved by nomads
description: A rapidly gentrifying residential district on a bay with Sugarloaf views, packed with craft bars, cafes, coworking spaces and a young creative crowd. Central, well-connected by metro and more affordable than the beach zones, it is a nomad favorite.
bestFor: Remote workers wanting cafes, coworking, nightlife and good value near the center

name: Santa Teresa
tagline: Bohemian hilltop of artists and views
description: A hilltop neighborhood of cobbled streets, colonial mansions, art studios and sweeping city views, reached by the historic tram. Bohemian and atmospheric, it draws artists and creatives, though its steep terrain sits away from the beaches.
bestFor: Creatives wanting an atmospheric artsy hillside with views and character

name: Leblon
description: The affluent neighborhood next to Ipanema, with Rio's priciest real estate, refined restaurants, boutiques and a calmer beach end. Safe, leafy and polished, Leblon suits nomads with bigger budgets who want tranquility beside the beach scene.
bestFor: Higher-budget nomads wanting a safe, refined beach neighborhood with fine dining
